messages:
Sarah M: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's outage — consolidating action items for vendor/dependency mitigations (cloud provider + model registry + auth). Can owners confirm timelines and whether they want these in the weekly ops sprint or a focused remediation sprint?
AJ: Thanks — I'll own the cloud provider fallback checklist. Plan: 2-week remediation sprint to validate cross-region failover + escalation runbook. Targeting completion: 2026-04-10.
Mike T: I'll pair on the runbook tests. Can we schedule a dry run next Tue? Need CI jobs to simulate token storms and model-registry auth failures.
Oncall Bot: Incident #2026-33021 created and linked to this thread. Pager duty rotations updated: Ibrahim assigned as primary for drill.
Rebecca Li: I'll take model-registry hardening (auth refresh token TTLs + retry/backoff). Proposal: add TTL jitter, circuit breaker at the registry client, and a cached fallback for read-only metadata. ETA: 2026-04-06.
Ibrahim (Ops Lead): Good. Two asks: (1) please add automated smoke tests that run after any model-registry deploy, (2) vendor contact escalation needs to be updated in PagerDuty (add CloudCo on-call 2nd line).
CloudCo Eng: Acknowledge. We'll provide updated maintenance SLAs and an escalation contact card by 2026-03-29. Also sending recommended retry windows for our auth endpoint.
AJ: Action items consolidated — I'll own the tracker. Quick list: 1) Cross-region failover drill (owner: AJ) — 2-week sprint; 2) Model-registry auth jitter + CB (owner: Rebecca) — 1-week; 3) Smoke tests on deploy (owner: Mike) — add to CI; 4) Vendor contact + SLA update (owner: CloudCo Eng) — 1 week; 5) Rollout canary windows and autoscaling policy review (owner: Ibrahim) — 2 weeks.
Sarah M: Please add owners and PR links in the tracker. We need clear acceptance criteria: recovery under 60s for control-plane ops and no model-serving 5xx during simulated auth failures.
Mike T: Scheduling the dry run: placing calendar invite for Tue 10:30am PT. I'll add the simulation script to infra-testing repo: scripts/simulate_auth_token_storm.sh (will post PR).
Rebecca Li: I'll draft the model-registry PR today and include unit tests for jitter + CB. Also adding a metric: "model_registry_auth_error_rate" and an alert at 0.5% over 5m.
Ibrahim (Ops Lead): Good. Also recommend adding a recurring monthly mini-drill for vendor fallbacks (15m), owners rotate. Let's make it opt-out for critical services.
AJ: Noted — I'll add the recurring on-call checklist to the ops calendar and create a short runbook play: /docs/ops/vendor-fallback-mini-drill.md
CloudCo Eng: We'll run a joint DR drill with Redwood in two weeks — propose 2026-04-08, tentative, pending your sprint.
Sarah M: Decision: keep remediation items in a focused sprint (AJ lead) but do the mini-drill monthly for 6 months to watch for regression patterns. We'll review metrics after 3 drills.
Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run simulation test in 2 days; mini-drill created as recurring calendar event.
Mike T: Quick note — add canary percentage and rollback triggers to the rollout playbook. Small patch + rollback if error rate > 1% for 2m.
Rebecca Li: I'll own the canary checks for model-registry. Will add alerting runbooks and smoke test pass/fail criteria.
Sarah M: Thanks everyone. AJ, when you have the tracker link drop it here and I'll mark owner approvals. Also let's ensure PMs for impacted product teams are CC'd on the rollout comms. :thumbsup:
